level: >= 25% of book equity from the high-water mark
observable_from: /blend/feed equity_curve (X-Read-Token; one point per cycle-day; until 2026-10-05 the HWM and DD were computed by hand from it - the executor now tracks them, see below). NOT /status (intraday marks only, no history); a cycle-day point can be marked at the STOP level for an unquoted held name (_mark_price), bounded by open risk (<= ~3% of book): confirm a borderline reading against the next day. 2026-10-05 (instrument built): /blend/feed tripwires.book (flow-adjusted drawdown, hwm_date, since; bootstrapped from the persisted equity curve) and an ALERT-ONLY WARN page on the crossing. Corrected after review the same night: the HWM ratchets on FINALIZED daily closes (the day's last in-session mark) only, and a line pages when the last TWO finalized closes are over it.
basis: executor-fidelity replay of the live 30/70 rules: realized max DD 28.3% (2020-02-20 -> 2020-03-23, SPY-led), bootstrap p5/p50/p95 14.6/26.3/40.1%; the sleeve-led 2022 bear reached 20.4% on the book
action_as_coded: none on the book; a written review within 5 sessions (fills vs entry_ref, missed entries, stop placement, unreconciled, regime) logged in this ledger
review_rule: re-derive from the then-current mirror results JSON; re-arm or re-level; 'resolved' = fired (date in notes) or superseded
notes: Written 38 days AFTER go-live (money moved 2026-08-28), against the IC rule that tripwires precede money; recorded as such. Measured-curve caveat: book_value credits no SPY dividends or BIL distributions (cash reconcile is alert-only), ~2 pp/yr of drag vs the total-return replay, so live drawdowns read deeper and underwater clocks longer than the replay basis. PENDING (due at the first R1 monthly review or when the feed is pasted, whichever first): hwm_at_write, hwm_date and the equity_curve's FIRST date — that read also verifies 'no re-seed since 2026-08-28'. 2026-10-05 (same day, later): a deposit is being adopted into the book through stage-2 cash adoption (POST /blend/cash/adopt); the feed now carries book.capital_contributed and capital_events (seed + adopted deposits with dates and amounts). Compute the HWM and the drawdown on the FLOW-ADJUSTED series by CHAIN-LINKING: on each capital_events date of kind deposit_adopted ONLY (the 'seed' row is the curve's first point and the 'inferred' row is the seed backfilled at the stage-2 build's first boot, dated by that boot - neither is a flow) take the day's return as (E_d - usd_d)/E_{d-1} - 1, cumulate into an index, read HWM/DD off the index. Do NOT subtract the deposits from the points: that dollar series overstates the % drawdown after a deposit (seed 50k, HWM 52k, adopt 70k, fall to 100k: chain-linked 18.0%, subtracted 42.3%, a false crossing of both review lines; counter-agent A4). The raw curve steps up by the deposit and would mask a drawdown in progress. 2026-10-05 (instrument built): the pending HWM read is now published continuously - tripwires.book.hwm_date / drawdown on the feed (Execution tab panel); tripwires.book.since is the equity curve's first date, so 'no re-seed since 2026-08-28' is verified when it reads 2026-08-28. Reinvested dividends adopted with kind 'distribution' are RETURN (not flows), so once they are adopted monthly the index is total-return; deposits ('deposit_adopted') are the only flows.
